label: Correctness
description: Training code samples contain syntax logical functionality API or dependency defects.

label: Security
description: Training code samples contain vulnerabilities credentials or high-risk implementation patterns.

label: Compliance
description: Training code samples violate legal ethical or regulatory requirements.

label: Robustness
description: Training-code fault-tolerance, input-validation, exception-handling, or boundary-checking patterns; path-level direction and qualifiers distinguish stronger practices from deficits.

label: Maintainability
description: Training code samples have structures that are difficult to modify extend or reuse.

label: Understandability
description: Training code samples express logic or intent unclearly.

label: Efficiency
description: Training code samples contain resource-wasting or algorithmically suboptimal implementations.

label: Compliance and Security Risks (Textual)
description: Non-code textual training content is harmful copyright-infringing or privacy-leaking.

label: Distribution Imbalance Issues
description: The corpus is uneven across languages domains resources data types tasks or difficulty.

label: Redundancy Issues
description: The corpus contains duplicate near-duplicate or excessively repetitive samples.

label: Inadequate Diversity
description: The corpus insufficiently covers scenarios domains edge cases environments or solution forms.

label: Data Contamination Risks
description: Training data overlap with evaluation benchmarks or otherwise leak test solutions.

label: Low-Value Data
description: Training data contributes little useful learning signal or introduces noise and error.

label: Defect-Pattern Carryover
description: Groups atomically coded relations whose final RQ2 source is a Correctness defect within code, while retaining each observed final RQ1 target branch.

label: Vulnerability-Pattern Carryover
description: Groups atomically coded relations from Security defects within code to downstream non-Compliance generated-code quality problems.

label: Restricted/Sensitive-Content Reproduction Risks
description: Groups atomically coded governance, privacy, licensing, harmful-content, and sensitive-content relations whose final generated outcome is Compliance.

label: Robustness-Pattern Associations
description: Groups atomically coded relations from fault-tolerance, input-validation, exception-handling, or boundary-checking patterns in training code to generated-code Robustness or task-specific Correctness outcomes.

label: Structural-Quality Associations
description: Groups atomically coded relations whose final RQ2 source is a Maintainability defect within code.

label: Clarity-Pattern Associations
description: Groups atomically coded relations whose final RQ2 source is an Understandability defect within code.

label: Efficiency-Pattern Carryover
description: Groups atomically coded relations whose final RQ2 source is an Efficiency defect within code.

label: Prevalence-Associated Quality Skew
description: Groups atomically coded relations from relative prevalence, representation, allocation, or distribution mismatch in the training data.

label: Redundancy-Associated Reinforcement and Degeneration
description: Groups atomically coded relations from duplicate, cloned, or highly similar samples within the training corpus.

label: Underexposure-Associated Quality Gaps
description: Groups atomically coded relations from missing or insufficient task, domain, language, API, temporal, security, performance, or format coverage.

label: Contamination-Associated Familiarity Differences
description: Groups atomically coded relations from verified or explicitly qualified potential overlap between training data and evaluation material.

label: Supervision-Signal Quality Associations
description: Groups atomically coded relations from noisy, erroneous, low-information, irrelevant, malformed, or misaligned non-code supervision.

label: Security
description: Generated code contains weaknesses permitting unauthorized access disclosure alteration or unsafe execution.

label: Compliance
description: Generated code violates legal ethical or regulatory constraints.

label: Robustness
description: Generated code cannot remain stable under abnormal inputs boundary conditions or non-malicious runtime disruptions.

label: Maintainability
description: Generated code is difficult to modify extend or reuse without introducing risk.

label: Understandability
description: Humans have difficulty comprehending the generated code's logic intent or structure.

label: Efficiency
description: Generated code unnecessarily consumes time or memory resources.

label: Correctness
description: Generated code fails to implement intended semantics or to execute validly.

label: Generation Derailment
description: The generated response departs from the task-directed course needed to provide a usable code deliverable.
